rationale: The short thesis remains intact — price is still ~0.9% below VWAP ($33.75) and under the 9-EMA ($33.55), the failed gap and prior-close magnet ($33.11) are unchanged, and no new headlines have emerged — so exiting a modest winner is not justified. However, the drift has stalled above the $33.35 low on drying 1m volume and SPY has recovered half its loss (-0.64% to -0.32%), which removes any edge for flipping long against the still-bearish daily structure. Holding with the original $33.80 invalidation keeps risk defined while the setup still points lower.
